metric_definitions.units: Unshifted full-length linear PCM, source PCM16 divided by32768; float64 reductions over frames and both channels
metric_definitions.cpu_vulkan: Reference=CPU; candidate=Vulkan. Error=candidate-reference, RMS=sqrt(mean(error²)), maximum=max(abs(error)), bias=mean(error), relative RMS=error RMS/reference RMS
metric_definitions.decibels: 20log10(relative RMS); null when reference RMS is zero or error is exactly zero. exact_zero_error distinguishes zero error
metric_definitions.lag: Channel-demeaned zero-padded FFT cross correlation summed across channels, normalized by full-signal energies, searched within±256samples. Positive lag means Vulkan occurs later than CPU. No signals are shifted for raw errors. Periodic or weak signals may give ambiguous peaks
metric_definitions.recombination: Unshifted sum of four stems minus source; bias_per_channel is DC residual. This is not a separation-quality score
metric_definitions.joins: At kHOP and kHOP+OVERLAP for k>=1 inside source. Jump=sample[b]-sample[b-1]; neighborhood derivatives use±20ms, clipped at source edges. No pass thresholds or attribution of artifacts
metric_definitions.references: Only supplied aligned reference WAVs produce reference metrics; raw amplitude/phase alignment retained, no gain fitting or time shifting

numerical_diagnostics.join_scope: 18 time locations (3 hop boundaries plus3 overlap exits per clip), each measured in source and both backends/four stems. Actual transients can dominate derivatives; no click/quality pass threshold or causal artifact label is added.

sequence.scope: Bounded sequential music quality preparation, no UI/audio playback load and no sustained latency qualification.

lifecycle.native_pid_absence_scope: Successful host sequence checks native PIDs after each driver and completed both backends. No separate retained PID-existence snapshot or fresh host query is added here.

limits: Each backend contributes only12continuous hops; nearest-rank p95/p99 are the observed maximum. These sequential quality runs have no audio/UI load and do not establish sustained tail performance.
The music Vulkan p99/max exceeds4.095s despite the earlier synthetic software-UI hour passing. Both observations must remain visible; CPU is not viable for this live budget.
CPU uses F32 expanded weights and Vulkan native F16 storage. CPU agreement is a numerical implementation comparison, not isolated-stem ground truth or an audible quality verdict.
Same-backend seek parity is an identity/regression result. Successful seek suffixes are sample-exact; no new cancellation/preemption or end-to-end playback claim follows.
Near-silent reference stems can have high relative errors despite small absolute error. Sum-of-stems residual includes model behavior and the per-stem global-mean restoration convention.

Whole-source normalization mirrors the pinned offline session; fixed zero-padded source-grid tail planning differs from its centered-tail planning. Dataset local excerpts also set their own whole-source normalization.

Process VmRSS/VmHWM, DRM per-client maxima and sampled GPU frequency are separate observations; maxima must not be summed into a total memory peak or interpreted as continuous clocks. Denied RAPL reads are unknown, not zero.
Temperature/policy observations include startup and all seek work; samples do not prove sustained heat, and brief spikes remain acceptable to the user. Other mapped sensors remain unsampled.

MP3/WAV previews and NPY arrays remain local/excluded from Git. Lossless previews preserve the candidate samples with shared preview processing; neither preview nor numeric metrics replace the pending human listening decision.
